verdict.rationale: Expensify's AI assistant ('Ask Expensify AI anything') is documented as giving instant answers and charts about anything in the account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis. That is AI-generated insight from the user's own data, inside the product. It also lets users fix setup mistakes and configure rules just by asking, which touches on guidance. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (rather than answers to questions), in-depth product docs beyond a blog post, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
